messages:
anya: Quick heads up — ACME Cloud is asking for a per-token override for embeddings during their POC. They estimate ~2B embedding tokens over 30 days and want the min charge waived. Can we do a temporary hosted-rate exception?
marco: Do we have the token split (embeddings vs gen) and whether they will stream or batch?
anya: Rough breakdown pasted from the engineer: 1.9B embedding tokens (dense vectors), ~100M context tokens. All batch uploads via our embeddings endpoint. They want $0.0003/embedding-token for the pilot and no min.
leo: We can consider a short-term promo but need finance signoff and a liability cap. Also want to capture how this scales post-POC.
nisha: Quick calc: at $0.0003/token * 1.9B = $570k revenue/month. If they actually do 2B tokens incl. context approx $600k. That rate is below our published tier floor for bulk embeddings. Without a min charge the downside is large if they underdeliver.
anya: They're pushing because competitors offered cheaper pilot pricing. Customer insists on "no min, just usage" for evaluation.
samir: Legal flags: if we waive min we should add a 30-day limitation clause, a usage cap to cap our exposure, and an MSA addendum referencing pricing. Also run the security questionnaire answers for hosted (they insisted on hosted not private).
billing-bot: Deal lookup: open deal D-2025-331, no existing special pricing on file. Current ratecard shows embeddings floor $0.0005/token for >500M.
marco: Proposal from SE side: approve a 30-day temporary override with conditions — rate $0.00035/embedding-token, waive min only if they sign an addendum that includes a usage cap (2.2B hard cap) and a post-POC review call to convert to committed pricing. Include telemetry requirements (batch size, concurrency) so our cost estimates hold.
nisha: Finance will approve if we: 1) hard cap usage, 2) require chargeback for any overage at published tier rate, 3) create a refundable credit buffer in case of dispute. I'll draft pricing terms. :+1:
leo: Sounds reasonable. @anya please prepare a 1-pager for the customer with the billing example and the addendum. I will coordinate the commercial email.
anya: On it — will include example math and a short runbook for batching to keep their cost predictable. Sending draft before EOD.
marco: Also note: recommend enabling prefix/KV caching for repeated uploads, that could reduce token count. I'll add engineering notes.
anya: Thanks — looping in @samir for the addendum language once draft ready.
samir: happy to review, please tag me when the doc is up.
leo: Great — if we get approval from @nisha and legal signoff, sales will push the temporary override.
anya: Closing loop: will post the draft here once ready and ping for final signoff.
